title: API Management Policies
description: Master APIM policies — the rules that transform, secure, and control API requests and responses.

data.text: Policies in APIM are XML snippets that run on the gateway. They let you change request or response behavior without touching the backend code. Common uses include validation, transformation, caching, and rate limiting.
Policies can be applied at different scopes: global (all APIs), product, API, or operation. More specific policies override less specific ones.

data.title: Common Policy Statements
items: validate-jwt — validate a JWT token against Entra ID
rate-limit-by-key — throttle requests per key or IP
set-backend-service — redirect to a different backend
transform — modify the request or response body

data.title: Enforce JWT Validation with a Policy
data.content: Require a valid JWT token issued by Entra ID before forwarding the request.
data.code:
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <validate-jwt header-name="Authorization"
      failed-validation-httpcode="401"
      failed-validation-error-message="Invalid or missing token">
      <openid-config url="https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration" />
      <required-claims>
        <claim name="aud" match="any">
          <value>{api-client-id}</value>
        </claim>
      </required-claims>
    </validate-jwt>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>

data.title: Rate Limit by Subscription Key
data.content: Limit each consumer to 100 calls per minute.

data.title: Add a Caching Policy
data.description: Add a cache-lookup and cache-store policy to an APIM operation to reduce backend calls for GET requests.
steps: Navigate to your API in APIM and open the Design tab.
Add a <lookup> policy in the inbound section for GET operations.
Add a <store> policy to cache responses for 60 seconds.
Send repeated GET requests and verify the backend receives fewer calls.
data.expectedOutcome: Repeated identical GET requests are served from the APIM cache.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Policies are XML rules executed at the APIM gateway.
They can validate tokens, throttle traffic, cache, and transform requests.
Apply policies at the narrowest scope that meets your needs.
data.takeaway: APIM policies let you add cross-cutting concerns without changing backend code.
